subject: FY2021 Budget Hearing Format
overview: The Medford City Council met remotely to address meeting format disputes for upcoming FY2021 budget hearings, approve a $1.5 million Water and Sewer retained earnings transfer, and receive extensive public input. The Council also voted on several resolutions regarding city communications, grant applications, and commission ordinances.

items.title: Budget Hearing Format Resolutions
items.summary: The Council tabled resolutions 20-461 and 20-459 following debate regarding remote versus in-person formats for upcoming budget hearings, agreeing to convene a leadership meeting with city officials.

items.title: Water and Sewer Retained Earnings Appropriation
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $1,500,000 from Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund retained earnings to subsidize the FY2021 budget, and approved a B-paper asking the administration to explore a Home Rule petition for additional funding options.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Dozens of residents spoke regarding meeting accessibility, public health guidelines, budget priorities, councilor attendance, equity, and police funding.

items.title: Routine Resolutions Tabled or Withdrawn
items.summary: Tabled resolutions 20-421, 20-423, and 20-425, and noted the withdrawal of resolutions 20-450 and 20-457.

items.title: Women and Gender Equity Commission Ordinance
items.summary: Referred resolution 20-451 to a Committee of the Whole to advance an ordinance establishing a Women and Gender Equity Commission.

items.title: Saltonstall Road Shooting Report Request
items.summary: Approved resolution 20-453 requesting a report from the city administration regarding a recent shooting on Saltonstall Road.

items.title: Free Cash Policy Request
items.summary: Approved resolution 20-454 requesting the city's existing free cash policy.

items.title: Subcommittee on Communications and Public Engagement
items.summary: Referred resolution 20-455 to create a subcommittee on communications and public engagement to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Public Participation Guide and Agenda Accessibility
items.summary: Referred resolution 20-456 to a Committee of the Whole to create a multilingual public participation guide and improve agenda file accessibility.

items.title: Shared Streets and Spaces Grant Application
items.summary: Approved resolution 20-458 calling on the city to apply for MassDOT's Shared Streets and Spaces Grant to support outdoor dining and local commerce.

items.title: Committee Reports and Meeting Records
items.summary: Tabled committee reports and the meeting records of June 9, 2020, while approving the meeting records of June 16, 2020.
